title: SQL Lab
targetPerformance: After 20 hours, solve 9 of 10 shop-query tasks in 40 minutes, including joins, HAVING, a subquery, ranking and running totals; then complete the revenue-report build and boss without hints.
whyItMatters: Turn business questions into reproducible SQLite queries with the correct output grain.

subskills.title: Select and filter
subskills.why: Practice select and filter to answer shop reporting questions.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check projected column order and inclusive filter boundaries.

subskills.title: Sort with tie breakers
subskills.why: Practice sort with tie breakers to answer shop reporting questions.
subskills.selfCorrection: Resolve ties with an id; manually trace the first two rows.

subskills.title: Join at the correct grain
subskills.why: Practice join at the correct grain to answer shop reporting questions.
subskills.selfCorrection: Count unmatched customers and repeated order rows before aggregating.

subskills.title: Group and filter summaries
subskills.why: Practice group and filter summaries to answer shop reporting questions.
subskills.selfCorrection: Name the output grain and compare COUNT(*) with COUNT(non-null id).

subskills.title: Compose subqueries
subskills.why: Practice compose subqueries to answer shop reporting questions.
subskills.selfCorrection: Run the inner query alone; test a customer with no matches.

subskills.title: Number and rank rows
subskills.why: Practice number and rank rows to answer shop reporting questions.
subskills.selfCorrection: Separate the window ordering from final output ordering; test tied prices.

subskills.title: Accumulate and integrate
subskills.why: Practice accumulate and integrate to answer shop reporting questions.
subskills.selfCorrection: Trace the first row and an equal-date peer; explicitly choose a ROWS frame.

resources.title: SQLite SELECT
resources.why: Check clause order, join semantics and grouping.

resources.title: SQLite window functions
resources.why: Look up ranking and explicit ROWS frames.

resources.title: SQLite Tutorial
resources.why: Review short worked examples before another drill.

barriers.fix: Use the browser SQL runner; each challenge recreates the same seeded shop.

barriers.barrier: Too many SQL clauses at once
barriers.fix: Write the output grain first, then add one clause and inspect the rows.
Record one counterexample and retry a five-minute drill; failures still earn progress.
